bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and bags larger than 9 x 11 inches must be checked. Coat and bag check is available and takes credit cards only.
prohibited: Backpacks or bags larger than 9 x 11 inches (must be checked)

parking.summary: Smartbar has no dedicated parking. Metered street parking is available on Clark Street, plus several pay lots nearby, and you can book a spot ahead through SpotHero.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Smartbar. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Smartbar hasn't published food and drink details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

accessibility.summary: Smartbar is one flight of stairs down at basement level and is not wheelchair accessible. If you need accommodations or other help, buy your ticket first, then email ask@metrochicago.com at least two weeks before the event.

reEntry.summary: Smartbar hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Smartbar is 21 and over without exception, and you need one physical, valid federal or state ID, such as a driver's license, state ID, Armed Forces ID or passport. Door tickets are cash only, and a limited number are held for the door even when a show is listed as sold out, subject to capacity.

gates.summary: Enter at 3730 N Clark Street and take one flight of stairs down to the club. Doors usually open around 10 pm, entry is first come, first served, and arriving early is suggested since entry depends on capacity.
